primary_checks.locator: References 47-48 and abstract; confirms S782 uses the Lappalainen and Shiu model papers as background and studies antennal grooming network coordination.
Abstract, Results, version history; connectome-based mechanosensory circuit anatomy and stimulus-aimed grooming, without a fitted dynamic connectome model.
Full text and abstract; connectome-constrained whole-brain spontaneous-activity dynamics. This existing S739 record was recovered in the forward page and was not a new source.

Methods ?3 (full adult FAFB connectome, conductance-based LIF, oriented visual stimuli); Limitations (no in-vivo validation; simplified LIF); References [46] cites Shiu et al., the existing S775 paper. This is a visual-method analogue, not nociception/ECAP/SCS evidence.
Official NeurIPS 2025 Main Conference proceedings entry; title/authors and DOI 10.52202/085713-5498 match the arXiv work.

Primary eLife full-text JATS for Calle-Schuler et al., eLife 14:RP108044 (DOI 10.7554/eLife.108044.3); Abstract/Results describe connectome anatomy and stimulus-aimed grooming. It is a circuit/behavior lead, not a dynamics-model analogue.

conclusion: A new method-level connectome-constrained dynamics analogue was identified in the primary reference list of arXiv:2609.01330v1 (citing S775); its optic-lobe visual task lacks in-vivo validation and is not a nociception, grooming/escape, pain, ECAP, or SCS analogue. The separate Calle-Schuler eLife lead remains related circuit/behavior prior art without fitted dynamics. PA-01 remains open: the sampled citation/index and targeted query coverage do not complete NS-01-NS-04 exact/synonym/author searches, full backward/forward snowballing, or saturation.

additional_primary_leads.title: Connectome-Based Modelling Reveals Orientation Maps in the Drosophila Optic Lobe
additional_primary_leads.authors: Jia-Nuo Liew; Shenghan Lin; Bowen Chen; Wei Zhang; Xiaowei Zhu; Wei Zhang; Xiaolin Hu
additional_primary_leads.citation_relation: Cites S775 (Shiu et al. 2024) as reference 46; primary text lines 267-268.
primary_locators: Abstract and Methods > LIF model, HTML lines 60-63 and 111-118: FAFB connectome with 138,639 neurons and 1,508,983 synapses; conductance-based LIF simulation driven by visual stimulus inputs.
Discussion > Limitations, HTML lines 212-214: authors state there is no in-vivo validation and simplified LIF omits nonlinear firing dynamics and neurotransmitter effects.
References, HTML lines 267-268: S775 is explicitly cited as Shiu et al. 2024, Nature 634:210-219.
Appendix A, HTML lines 755-757: code/data URL https://github.com/JNLiew/flylif_orientation_maps.
additional_primary_leads.classification: New primary method-level connectome-dynamics analogue for NS-02; narrower optic-lobe visual coding task. It does not model nociception, grooming/escape behavior, or measure experimental neural/behavioral validation, human pain, ECAP, or SCS outcomes.
additional_primary_leads.publication_status: arXiv v1 submitted 2026-09-01; arXiv page comments state "NeurIPS 2025", which was not independently verified against proceedings in this pass.
additional_primary_leads.triage: Add as a candidate for later canonical-card review; this bounded audit itself does not publish or validate a corpus card.
